notes: Authoritative record spec for the Dunmer HYBRID pilot: an ancestor SUBSTRATE (no-offer) plus a focused RECLAMATION foreground (offer via shared active-patron state). Same substrate family as the proven Khajiit pilot and the Argonian draft. The ancestor substrate (PDV_Substrate_DunmerAncestor, StorageUtil keys PDV.Substrate.DunmerAncestor.*) carries the always-active identity layer with NO passive decay (ledger: Skyrim lacks tombs/House shrines and that absence must not punish the player). The Reclamation foreground is the real piety faucet via the offer/active-patron path (one foreground focus at a time). Broad worship is a STATE (R1): broad-lane reward is granted by the broad-worship reward path keyed on the race state, NOT an aggregate deity; broad T1 uses the FIXED manager property PDV_Bless_Dunmer_Reclamation_T1 (R2) and broad T2 is PDV_Bless_Dunmer_Reclamation_T2. The three focusable Reclamation patrons (Azura/Boethiah/Mephala) each get a 3-tier set (R3, Khajiit naming). Azura REUSES the existing PDV_Deity_Azura (create:false, add Stance_Dunmer -- the shared-deity reconciliation); Boethiah and Mephala are Dunmer-owned NEW deities (create:true). Do NOT implement PDV_State_DunmerPath. Double-route mirrors Khajiit/Argonian: each devotional act records on the substrate AND sends a small honest piety pulse to the active Reclamation patron, with separate anti-farm tools. Magnitudes mirror the proven Khajiit/Argonian substrate power level; no magnitude exceeds ~12%. T3 NPC recognition is V1-deferred (PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md); V1 T3 ships stat/signature effects with Champion Survey text as the recognition surface. All player-facing text is ASCII-only and uses Skyrim ActorValue names only.

emphasisLayerDesignNote: Per the ledger Focused Pass: Dunmer (Overstack Risk) and R8 two-family cap. Family one is the ancestor substrate triad (always-active identity, low-power, NO decay). Family two is the ONE Reclamation foreground the player runs (Azura OR Boethiah OR Mephala -- one focus at a time via shared active-patron state). The broad Reclamation set (PDV_Bless_Dunmer_Reclamation_T1/T2, R1 state-keyed, R2 fixed editorId) is the broad-state lane the player has BEFORE choosing a primary focus; it is intentionally below the focused patron T3 ceiling (broad < focused, R8). The three patron 3-tier sets are NOT three simultaneous packages: only the active focus is granted (mirrors SyncKhajiitEmphasisRewards/SyncKhajiitEmphasisFamily, one active focus). Good Daedra are kept from paying as three equal foreground packages (ledger). Themes are legibly Dunmer: Azura twilight/foresight (MagickaRateMult/ResistMagic), Boethiah struggle/strength (OneHanded/DamageResist), Mephala secrets/cunning (Sneak/Illusion). No magnitude exceeds ~12%.

doubleRoute.summary: Same pattern as the Khajiit and Argonian double-route. Each maintenance act records on the SUBSTRATE (PDV_Substrate_DunmerAncestor, anti-farm ConsumeDailyRepeatMultiplier 0.7^n) AND sends a SMALL honest piety pulse to the ACTIVE Reclamation patron (anti-farm ScoreRepeatableAction). The two mechanisms are never both applied to one magnitude: the substrate side and the pulse side carry separate, independent anti-farm tools (R8). The Reclamation foreground itself is the offer/active-patron faucet -- the real progression engine -- while the substrate maintenance keeps the always-active ancestor layer alive (with NO passive decay) and the pulse keeps neglect/creed-loss honest on the universal piety layer.

pace.model: hybrid: substrate-led ancestor layer (no piety faucet) PLUS an offer/active-patron Reclamation foreground (real piety faucet), mirroring the Khajiit substrate cadence for the substrate and the Imperial-style offer cadence for the foreground.
pace.substrateCadence: Portable ash-prayer (PrayerDelta 5.0) and home rite (HomeBonusDelta 8.0), each capped one per day by ConsumeDailyRepeatMultiplier 0.7^n. About 5 prayer signals reach the MID substrate tier (25); roughly 15 reach HIGH (75) at full per-day value. With the 0.7^n same-day decay and a natural few maintenance beats per in-game week, MID lands in roughly 1 in-game week and HIGH in roughly 3 in-game weeks of ordinary non-grind play. There is NO passive decay, so the substrate never erodes between sessions.
pace.foregroundCadence: The Reclamation foreground is the real faucet: curated Azura/Boethiah/Mephala acts grant active-patron piety via the offer path (T1>=Seeker 25 / T2>=Devoted 50 / T3>=Champion 85), one focus at a time. Curated sources are rarer and more meaningful than the substrate maintenance beat, so the foreground rewards intentional Reclamation commitment rather than a grindable loop.
pace.pietyPulseRole: The small +1 pulse per substrate maintenance act to the active Reclamation patron is NOT the progression race; it only keeps the universal piety layer (neglect/creed-loss) honest so the substrate-led ancestor layer does not float free of the shared piety mechanics.
pace.decayBalance: Ancestor substrate has NO passive dawn decay (ledger). Neglect is purely posture-gated -- gentle ancestor-silence texture at Strained, a single -5% MagickaRateMult bite only at the Silent curse posture. Ordinary play stays net-positive; a neglected Dunmer drifts toward Strained flavor but is not punished mechanically unless cursed to Silent.

v1RecognitionSurface: Champion Survey/status text only (non-voiced). The Azura/Boethiah/Mephala T3 Champion recognition surfaces are V1 Survey text only; voiced NPC recognition lines (Grey Quarter / diaspora solidarity reactions) are V2 per PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md and the ledger 'Needs custom content' note.
budget: OVERSTACK RISK (PDV_RaceRewardBudgetLedger Focused Pass: Dunmer). Two always-on families at the cap: the ancestor substrate triad (Layer 1, always-active identity, NO decay) plus the one Reclamation foreground the player runs (Layer 2, offer/active-patron, one focus at a time). The broad Reclamation state set (R1, T1/T2, R2 fixed editorId) is the pre-focus broad lane and stays below the focused patron T3 ceiling (broad < focused). The three patron 3-tier sets are NOT three packages -- only the active focus grants. Good Daedra do NOT pay as three equal foreground packages. PDV_State_DunmerPath is NOT implemented. Ceiling = ancestor substrate + one Reclamation foreground (ledger). No magnitude exceeds ~12%.
